Shun Premier 6 1/2 " Serrated Utility knife - This style of knife is often called a tomato or sandwich knife  but it's so much more versatile than that description would imply.  Of course  it works beautifully on most anything you would put in a sandwich - from meat to cheese to tomato slices.  What's more  the serrations will handily cut the sandwich in half when it's done.  Yet because of its medium size  this beautiful knife can handle many of the tasks of a small chef's knife or large paring knife  such as vegetable trimming. Many cooks also like it for taking on the tougher task of cutting through sausages with tough casings.
